disposition_reason: Tables 1 and 2 print mean ± dispersion of Cd, Pb, Ni, Fe and Cu in carrot and potato from four Osun State markets and their overall average.

study.design: Market survey with health risk assessment
study.origin: not stated (vegetables distributed from farms through these markets)
study.market: Atakumosa (Oja-oba) and Sabo markets (Ilesa East LGA), Esa-Oke and Ijebu-jesa markets (Obokun-Oriade LGA), Osun State, Nigeria

period.as_reported: three sampling periods in April and June 2025

study.method: Aqua regia digestion (1 g, 90 C, 60 min); flame AAS (PerkinElmer Analyst 400) with deuterium background correction
study.qa: NIST SRM 1573a tomato leaves; recoveries 93.5-104%; duplicates and blanks every 10 samples; RSD <5%

unresolved: Table 3 averages carrot and potato together by market; these combined values are not a single food and were not extracted.
Section 4.1 swaps carrot and potato in one sentence (says 0.718 mg/kg Pb and 0.235 mg/kg Cd "in the potato"); Tables 1 and 2 assign these to carrot, which was followed.
Per-market n not stated directly; 72 composites over 4 markets x 2 vegetables x 3 periods x triplicate implies 9 per market per vegetable.
